bullets.text: Windows 11 Insider Preview Build 28020.1863 Released - This Canary Channel update includes general improvements and fixes for Insiders.
New Xbox Mode in Windows 11 - The latest Canary build introduces Xbox mode for a streamlined gaming experience on PCs.
Windows 11 Builds 26100.8313 and 26200.8313 Released - Gradual rollout of new features and performance improvements for Insiders.
Windows 11 Insider Preview Build 26220.8271 Available - This Beta Channel update brings notable fixes and new features.
